- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12596-12602 (inline diagnostic comment inside `_direct_inflight_review_run_on_branch`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comment says "this helper is the last guard before the destructive empty-commit push and fails open on any error" and "the fail-open contract itself is unchanged." Since PR #4987, the PR-named lookup path (lines 12638-12641) does NOT fail open: on a non-zero rc it echoes `listing-incomplete` and the caller treats that sentinel as "skip the push." The PR fixed the header comment at lines 12561-12563 to qualify this ("the PR-named lookup below does not"), but the inline diagnostic comment at lines 12596-12602 still claims the whole helper "fails open on any error" and that "the fail-open contract itself is unchanged."
  WHY: No runtime failure — this is a documentation inconsistency. But a maintainer reading this inline comment (the one adjacent to the actual `gh run list` call, not the header) would conclude the PR-named lookup path also fails open, which is wrong. The PR-named lookup fails safe: an incomplete listing blocks the push. This contradicts the header the PR just fixed, so the function now has two comments that disagree with each other about the same contract.
